reviewNotes: The third eighty big-craftable strings are translated directly from English. Glossary machine and Slime terms remain consistent, collectible numbering and quantities are exact, museum-piece descriptions retain their meaning, and hidden mystery labels stay byte-identical.

MushroomBox_Description.translation: Ciupercile cresc la fiecare câteva zile.

MushroomLog_Description.source: Grows mushrooms every so often. The more wild trees are nearby, the better it works.
MushroomLog_Description.translation: Produce ciuperci din când în când. Cu cât sunt mai mulți copaci sălbatici în apropiere, cu atât funcționează mai bine.

Obelisk_Description.source: A sinister-looking portal that radiates with evil energy.
Obelisk_Description.translation: Un portal cu aspect sinistru, care radiază energie malefică.

ObsidianVase_Description.source: A beautifully crafted ornamental vase made from obsidian and gold.
ObsidianVase_Description.translation: O vază ornamentală frumos lucrată din obsidian și aur.

OrnamentalHayBale_Description.source: A decorative piece for your farm.

OstrichIncubator_Description.source: Hatches ostrich eggs into baby ostriches. Place in a barn.
OstrichIncubator_Description.translation: Transformă ouăle de struț în pui de struț. Așază-l într-un hambar.

PinkyLemon_Name.preservationReason: The concealed fictional label intentionally remains byte-identical, including its question marks.

PinkyLemon_Description.preservationReason: The concealed fictional label intentionally remains byte-identical, including its question marks.

PlushBunny_Description.source: It's big, it's soft, and it's cute.

PrairieKingArcadeSystem_Description.source: Play 'Journey Of The Prairie King' at home!

PreservesJar_Description.source: Turns vegetables into pickles and fruit into jam.
PreservesJar_Description.translation: Transformă legumele în murături și fructele în gem.

RecyclingMachine_Description.translation: Transformă gunoiul prins la pescuit în resurse.

RedCanes_Description.source: A decorative piece for your farm.

RitualMask_Description.source: It's way too large to wear.
RitualMask_Description.translation: Este mult prea mare ca să poată fi purtată.

Scarecrow_Description.source: Prevents crows from attacking your crops. Has a limited radius (about 8 "tiles").
Scarecrow_Description.translation: Împiedică ciorile să-ți atace culturile. Are o rază limitată (aproximativ 8 „dale”).

SeasonalDecor_Description.source: This decoration changes with the seasons.
SeasonalDecor_Description.translation: Acest decor se schimbă odată cu anotimpurile.

SeasonalPlant_Description.source: An ornamental plant that changes with each season. It doesn't need to be watered.
SeasonalPlant_Description.translation: O plantă ornamentală care se schimbă cu fiecare anotimp. Nu trebuie udată.

SeedMaker_Description.source: Place crops inside to produce a varying amount of seeds. Doesn't work with fruit tree crops.
SeedMaker_Description.translation: Pune culturi înăuntru pentru a produce un număr variabil de semințe. Nu funcționează cu recoltele pomilor fructiferi.

SewingMachine_Description.source: Use to tailor clothes from the convenience of your home!
SewingMachine_Description.translation: Folosește-o ca să croiești haine comod, chiar acasă!

SignOfTheVessel_Description.source: A decorative piece for your farm.

SingingStone_Description.source: It rings out with a pure tone when struck.
SingingStone_Description.translation: Scoate un sunet pur când este lovită.

SkullBrazier_Description.source: Provides a moderate amount of light.
SkullBrazier_Description.translation: Oferă o cantitate moderată de lumină.

SlimeEggPress_Description.source: Compresses 100 pieces of slime into a slime egg. It's a miracle of science!
SlimeEggPress_Description.translation: Comprimă 100 de bucăți de Slime într-un Ou de Slime. Este un miracol al științei!

SlimeIncubator_Description.source: Hatches slimes eggs into slimes. Allows you to raise slimes outdoors.
SlimeIncubator_Description.translation: Transformă Ouăle de Slime în Slime-uri. Îți permite să crești Slime-uri afară.

SlothSkeletonL_Description.source: This extinct sloth roamed the lush, prehistoric forests of Stardew Valley. Its powerful jaw tore through the toughest plant fibers.
SlothSkeletonL_Description.translation: Acest leneș dispărut cutreiera pădurile preistorice luxuriante din Stardew Valley. Maxilarul său puternic sfâșia chiar și cele mai tari fibre vegetale.

SlothSkeletonM_Description.source: The ribs of a prehistoric sloth.

SlothSkeletonR_Description.source: The hind legs and tail of a prehistoric sloth.
SlothSkeletonR_Description.translation: Picioarele din spate și coada unui leneș preistoric.

SodaMachine_Description.source: Keeps pumping out the good stuff.
SodaMachine_Description.translation: Continuă să producă băutura aceea bună.

SolarPanel_Description.source: Slowly generates batteries when left in the sun.
SolarPanel_Description.translation: Produce încet baterii când este lăsat la soare.
